A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same VisRet method and Visual-RAG-ME benchmark. All 17 pages of v2 and 19 pages of v3, including figures, equations and appendices, support reliable comparison and matching of relocated material.

before.justification: v2 reports original retrieval experiments across four benchmarks, downstream VQA results, model ablations and qualitative examples.

after.justification: v3 retains those original experiments and adds RzenEmbed retrieval results, aggregation analyses and failure cases.

M1.justification: The proposed procedure remains LLM instruction generation, synthesis of multiple visual queries, image-to-image retrieval and reciprocal rank fusion. Testing another embedding model and expanding explanations do not introduce a new method component.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate Visual-RAG, Visual-RAG-ME, INQUIRE-Rerank-Hard and COCO-Hard with the same represented tasks and data. Table 1 and Appendix A retain the same dataset sizes and filtering descriptions. Added analyses use existing coverage.

E2.justification: v3 Table 9 adds evaluated RzenEmbed-v2-7B-backed baseline comparisons on Visual-RAG and Visual-RAG-ME. This extends the comparator implementations while retaining the original-query, rewriting, BLIP captioning, VISA and captioning-reranking strategies. Existing CLIP/E5-V comparisons remain.

E3.justification: v3 adds evaluation with RzenEmbed-v2-7B and a per-query comparison of three-image fusion against its individual constituent visualizations. Existing dataset filtering, retrieval metrics, top-30 reranking and default three-image generation remain. Revised single-image scores do not establish a changed sampling protocol or reruns.

E4.justification: v3 substantially expands diagnostic analysis: Figure 3 compares generator failures, Figure 4 examines aggregation against individual samples, Figure 5 identifies failures at different pipeline stages, and Appendix C.5 tests a stronger retriever. Earlier generator, instruction-LLM and VQA ablations remain, mostly relocated to Appendix C.

E5.justification: Despite its 'Repeated Runs' heading, v3 Section 6.2 analyzes aggregation of the three generated visualizations already specified in v2. Neither version reports independent experimental run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, error bars or significance tests. The new win-count distribution is an aggregation analysis.

E6.justification: The retained main-table scores and relocated model/VQA ablations are unchanged. Single-image results are revised: E5-V INQUIRE-Rerank-Hard N@10 changes from 0.384 in v2 Table 2 to 0.292 in v3 Table 4, without explaining the revision. v3 also adds RzenEmbed results, aggregation findings, failure examples and a roughly fivefold VISA latency comparison.

T1.justification: Section 3.2 removes v2's assertion that generated queries satisfy v_i in I, where I denotes the retrieval corpus, and instead identifies each v_i as a synthesized image. This corrects a formal domain inconsistency. The retrieval formulation and reciprocal-rank-fusion equation otherwise remain unchanged.

C1.justification: The central method, benchmark contribution and headline retrieval/VQA claims remain unchanged. v3 emphasizes retriever robustness in the introduction and adds an explicit claim in Section 5.1 that VisRet is the only method in the image-to-image matching category as of December 2025, modestly sharpening its novelty positioning.

C2.justification: v2 already linked effectiveness to generator quality. v3 adds substantive explanations involving focus, factuality and instruction following, plus failures from omitted query requirements and embedding sensitivity to background or object appearance. It also explains limited aggregation gains through information overlap and discusses prompting remedies and deployment efficiency.

D1.justification: v3 adds annotation-process disclosures, including the two annotators, ambiguity resolution and auditing; explicitly states that generator comparisons share prompts; and identifies the RzenEmbed checkpoint with an access reference. Core prompts, hyperparameters and hardware information remain. The new latency claim lacks a detailed measurement protocol.

R1.justification: v3 removes the Bai et al. Qwen2.5-VL reference while retaining the model in Appendix B. It adds RzenEmbed/MMEB positioning and the explicit sole-method claim for image-to-image matching. The related-work categories and principal distinctions from earlier retrieval approaches remain substantially unchanged.

P1.justification: The abstract, introduction, approach, benchmark description and main-results prose undergo extensive rewriting. Section 6 is reorganized around module robustness, aggregation and success/failure analysis; earlier detailed analyses move to new Appendix C, and qualitative examples become Appendix D. This substantially changes the narrative structure.

P2.justification: v3 adds Figures 3–5 and the RzenEmbed table, separates the single-image ablation into Table 4, relocates several existing tables and changes the main tables' colors and Figure 2's styling. The resulting visual organization changes substantially, while existing success examples and prompt figures are retained.

improvement.justification: Compared with v2's emphasis on successful examples, v3 provides useful failure diagnoses and stronger-retriever validation through Figures 3–5 and Table 9. Reorganization and annotation disclosures also improve clarity and transparency. The net improvement is limited by unexplained single-image score revisions and sparse measurement details for the new latency claim; the principal experimental evidence remains unchanged.
